hint_ladder: Say that someone is getting better at something as time passes.
Use make with the noun progress; progress takes no do and no article.
Start with the words: She has made a lot of ___ with her English.
teaching_content.reveal_form: She has made a lot of progress with her English this year.
canonical_forms: She has made a lot of progress with her English this year.
alternative_realizations: We are making progress on the project.
